name: Takuwai Somari
source:
A cheeky kouhai whose true intentions are always a mystery. She seems to really respect [url=/c23153]Hanami[/url], and takes every chance she gets to be alone with her. 

She's also a member of the swimming team. She joined the frend-group last and is the youngest one of the five. 

[Based on the [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/dasaku/character04.html]official description[/url]]
